a short cue at your chosen interval so a: a short cue at your chosen interval so a long writing session keeps its rhythm. Settings has its own Problip tab: Start, Stop and Test.
announces 1 hour, 30, 15, 10 and 5 minut: announces 1 hour, 30, 15, 10 and 5 minutes before the nearest timer or the nearest known AI-limit reset. It never announces a moment that has already passed and never repeats one after a restart.
long-running background layers with thei: long-running background layers with their own volume and fades, triggered always, inside a time window, on a weekday, or by the weather.
no real mixing; sounds cannot overlap on: no real mixing; sounds cannot overlap on this system, so Overlay/Stack/Replace are unavailable.
off until you switch it on and type a pl: off until you switch it on and type a place with its latitude and longitude. Nothing else is sent, nothing is located automatically, and a failed lookup simply leaves the condition unknown.
one click silences everything at once: c: one click silences everything at once: clicks, alarms, voice phrases, Problip, previews, ambience and every queue. New sounds still work afterwards.
point it at ONE folder you already own;: point it at ONE folder you already own; recognised VOX, FVOX, G-Man and AMX clips are copied into your managed library. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is bundled with the app.
rapid repeats of the same sound are fold: rapid repeats of the same sound are folded together instead of piling up, ambience is never cut short by an ordinary Replace, and only STOP ALL SOUND or Stop ambience silences a background layer.
six bundled sounds; tick as many as you: six bundled sounds; tick as many as you like and each cue picks one at random. The last ticked sound cannot be unticked, and an unavailable file is marked instead of silently swapped.
today, this week, this month and the run: today, this week, this month and the running total. Only a cue that really played is counted. Reaching 100,000 is permanent.
whole sound sets you can apply, save, re: whole sound sets you can apply, save, rename, export and import. Imported files are copied into your own managed library, so the original folder is never needed again.
